elements.requirement: If a question arises whether the withholding of a landlord's consent to improvements required under section 97 was unreasonable, the landlord has the burden of showing that the withholding was not unreasonable.
elements.quote: it is for the landlord to show that it was not

elements.requirement: In determining whether the withholding of consent was unreasonable, the court must, in particular, have regard to the extent to which the improvement would be likely to make the dwelling-house, or any other premises, less safe for occupiers.
elements.quote: make the dwelling-house, or any other premises, less safe for occupiers

elements.requirement: In determining whether the withholding of consent was unreasonable, the court must, in particular, have regard to the extent to which the improvement would be likely to cause the landlord to incur expenditure which it would be unlikely to incur if the improvement were not made.
elements.quote: cause the landlord to incur expenditure which it would be unlikely to incur if the improvement were not made

elements.requirement: In determining whether the withholding of consent was unreasonable, the court must, in particular, have regard to the extent to which the improvement would be likely to reduce the price the dwelling-house would fetch if sold on the open market or the rent the landlord would be able to charge on letting the dwelling-house.
elements.quote: reduce the price which the dwelling-house would fetch if sold on the open market or the rent which the landlord would be able to charge on letting the dwelling-house

elements.requirement: A consent required by virtue of section 97 may be validly given even if it follows, rather than precedes, the action requiring it.
elements.quote: validly given notwithstanding that it follows, instead of preceding, the action requiring it

elements.requirement: Where a tenant has applied in writing for consent required by virtue of section 97, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement of the reason why consent was refused if the landlord refuses consent.
elements.quote: the landlord shall if it refuses consent give the tenant a written statement of the reason why consent was refused

elements.requirement: Where a tenant has applied in writing for consent required by virtue of section 97, consent is taken to have been withheld if the landlord neither gives nor refuses to give consent within a reasonable time.
elements.quote: if the landlord neither gives nor refuses to give consent within a reasonable time, consent shall be taken to have been withheld

thresholds.what: period after a tenant's written application within which a landlord must give or refuse consent before it is deemed withheld
